info.title: Kalakriti API
info.description: REST API for the Kalakriti platform — web and mobile clients

dev_role.description: Requests a token minted for BUYER, CLUSTER_OFFICER, or MINISTRY instead of the default ARTISAN. Only honored when the server is running with dev OTP enabled (AUTH_DEV_OTP_ENABLED) -- ignored otherwise, so this never does anything against a real deployment. There is currently no other way to obtain a token for any of these three roles.

post.summary: Request OTP to change the caller's registered phone number

200.description: OTP sent to the new number

post.summary: Verify OTP and complete the phone number change
post.description: On success, invalidates the caller's other active sessions and returns a fresh token pair.

craft_ids.description: Craft ontology UUIDs (from GET /crafts); at least one required, core-svc caps the max.

languages.description: commonv1.Language enum names without the LANGUAGE_ prefix, e.g. "HINDI", "ENGLISH".

201.description: Artisan created. The caller's prior token (minted at OTP-verify time, before this profile existed) has no subject and cannot authenticate further calls -- switch to access_token/refresh_token immediately, the same as after /auth/otp/verify.

get.description: Public callers only ever see PUBLISHED listings. An artisan who passes their own artisan_id also sees their own DRAFT, PENDING_ARTISAN_APPROVAL and SUSPENDED listings; a mismatched artisan_id is silently ignored and the published-only view applies.

post.description: Registers the product (photos, craft, dimensions) and its sellable offer in one call.

patch.description: Patches an existing listing. Fields omitted from the body keep their current server value; a commercial field sent as null explicitly clears it (stock_quantity only). Translations, when sent, replace the array wholesale. Media is not patchable here -- it is set at creation only.

get.description: What the model inferred (source MODEL) and what the artisan has since overridden (source ARTISAN). Same visibility as the listing itself: public once PUBLISHED, otherwise only the owning artisan or a curator.

post.description: Replaces the listing's media set wholesale, ordered, with at most one primary image and one process video. Triggers the cataloguing pipeline (enhance/extract attributes/generate description) once photos land on the listing.

post.summary: Submit listing for the artisan's own review
post.description: Moves the listing from DRAFT to PENDING_ARTISAN_APPROVAL. No request body.

The artisan's own sign-off on AI-generated copy. Moves the listing from PENDING_ARTISAN_APPROVAL to PUBLISHED. edited_translations, when sent, overrides the machine-generated translations with the artisan's edits before publishing.

Freezes process evidence for a PUBLISHED listing: hashes the given media, checks the artisan's claimed_technique against the model's observation, and (for textile crafts, unless skip_loom_check) records a loom verdict. Permanent -- nothing in the returned record can change after sealing.

media.description: Confirmed media ids -- the process evidence to freeze.

post.description: The returned upload_url is a presigned PUT to object storage, not a bff endpoint -- upload the raw bytes there directly, then call POST /media/{id}/confirm.
Tells core-svc the bytes were successfully PUT to upload_url. No request body.
Cost floor, market band and (when chosen_price is supplied) an anomaly check against it.

200.description: Search results with the understood query and removable filter chips

post.description: Body is the raw recorded audio, not JSON. The Accept-Language header (BCP-47, e.g. hi-IN) picks the transcription language.

200.description: Transcribed query and its search results

get.description: Returns the order with its lots populated. A lot's artisan_id identifies which lots belong to the calling artisan when there is more than one on the order.

text/event-stream, one `data:` line per event -- the wire shape is OrderEvent (see components.schemas). Supports Last-Event-ID for resume after a reconnect; replays persisted history first, then forwards live events, so a client that reconnects with its last-seen id sees no gap and no duplicate ahead of that id.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: RFC3339Nano instant; replay events after it before streaming live ones. Manual alternative to Last-Event-ID for a client managing its own reconnect.

post.summary: Accept or decline an offered lot
post.description: Only legal while the lot is OFFERED. Accepting requires promised_ship_date; declining requires decline_reason.

409.description: Lot is no longer awaiting a response

post.description: Legal from ACCEPTED, IN_PRODUCTION, or QC_FAILED (a rework resubmission back toward QC_PENDING -- must be reported at 100 to move out of QC_FAILED, a lower value there is rejected). Reaching 100 moves the lot to QC_PENDING.

409.description: Lot is not in a state that accepts a progress report

post.description: The non-punitive path when an artisan cannot complete an accepted lot: moves it straight to REALLOCATED and frees its units for reoffer to another artisan, rather than leaving it to silently miss its ship date or fail QC. Legal from ACCEPTED, IN_PRODUCTION or QC_FAILED.

409.description: Lot cannot be given up from its current state

get.description: Notifications addressed to the caller -- lot offers, order updates, follows -- newest first, up to 50. Group by `kind` client-side; there is no separate grouping endpoint.

403.description: Notification does not belong to the caller

get.description: Shown on the artisan's own profile as recognition -- how many buyers follow them -- not a metric framed for comparison or optimisation.

post.description: Kicks off generation for the caller's own period; period_end is inclusive of the whole day for a bare YYYY-MM-DD (rolled to the start of the next day server-side). Returns the full record immediately, including download_url -- there is no separate fetch-by-id (see GET /statements).

short_code.description: Public verification code, printable on the PDF.

get.summary: List the caller's own income statements
get.description: Newest first -- the earnings-over-time read model. insight-svc has no fetch-by-id, so this list (each row already carrying its own download_url) is the only way to see a statement generated earlier.

post.description: Registers a buyer requirement against one listing; allocation into per-artisan lots happens asynchronously (see /orders/{id}/events). Works for both READY_STOCK and MADE_TO_ORDER listings -- a single-item purchase is quantity: 1 through this same endpoint, there is no separate cart/checkout RPC.

amount_paise.description: Always integer paise. Never a float, never rupees.

currency_code.description: Defaults to INR, the only currency accepted today.

PriceAdvisory.description: POST /pricing/advise's response. recommended_min is server-clamped to never fall below the cost_floor driver's value -- see BuildAdvisory in core-svc/internal/core/domain/pricing.go.

value.description: Money-valued drivers carry a raw paise integer as a string; others carry plain text.

anomaly.description: Present whenever chosen_price was supplied, regardless of level -- level is NONE when the price is unremarkable, UNDERPRICED when it is below the cost floor, or OVERPRICED when it is above 1.5x the market p75. Absent entirely when chosen_price was not supplied.

qr_code.description: Verification URL carrying the record id -- link to the public provenance page.

OrderLot.description: One artisan's slice of a bulk order.

responds_by.description: The offer lapses to EXPIRED after this instant.

decline_reason.description: Set on decline, or as the give-up reason on REALLOCATED.

FeedItem.description: One notification -- a lot offer, an order update, a new follower -- addressed to the caller.

kind.description: e.g. LOT_OFFERED, ORDER_CONFIRMED, ARTISAN_FOLLOWED. Group the feed by this client-side.

payload.description: Deep-link context, e.g. order_id, lot_id, listing_id.

confidence.description: In [0,1]; an artisan's own answer is always 1.

ordinal.description: Display position; unique within the listing.

kind.description: Kind of the underlying asset; returned on reads, ignored on writes.

media.description: Confirmed media_ids from POST /media/{id}/confirm, primary image first.

UpdateListingRequest.description: Every field is optional -- only fields present in the body are changed. stock_quantity sent as JSON null explicitly clears it.

OnBehalfOf.name: X-On-Behalf-Of
OnBehalfOf.description: Assisted mode: a FIELD_AGENT or CLUSTER_OFFICER acting for a linked artisan (artisan id). Honoured only on allow-listed routes (services/bff/internal/bff/mosje/onbehalf.go); every other route answers 403 when it is present.
